svg.title: Car Key System
svg.desc: Logo CKS completo horizontal canonical (header + login + footer). Extraido del PDF master del Manual de Identidad Visual Corporativa Car Key System 2021. CARKEY (linea decorativa stroke), CKS (isotipo brand red #c5020e racing-cut italic), SYSTEM (linea decorativa stroke). Aspect ratio 1000x453 preservado del original. Fondo transparente.
